title: WAPC approval of survey-strata or strata lots for an existing authorised grouped or apartment development below Table 4B
text: M4.1.4 The WAPC, in consultation with the local government, may approve the creation of a survey-strata lot or strata lot for an existing authorised grouped dwelling or apartment development of a lesser minimum and average site area than that specified in Table 4B, where, in the opinion of the WAPC or the local government, the development on the resulting survey-strata or strata lots is consistent with the objectives of the relevant design elements of the R-Codes, and the orderly and proper planning of the locality.
notes: from: ch3 M4.1.4. diverges: covers existing authorised grouped dwelling or apartment development (Chapter 3 omits multiple dwellings); Table 4B for Table 3B. WAPC discretion, not an applicant test.
